retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast profile silhouette of a subject wearing reflective gold jewelry, set against a circular golden glow on a black background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark black silhouette of a male profile facing right, centered against a soft, circular amber-gold gradient. The only visible details are the glint of a small gold earring and the intricate, reflective texture of multiple thick gold chains around the neck.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject silhouette against a centered circular glow
Reflective gold textures contrasting with matte black shadows
Profile orientation creating a sharp graphic edge
Minimalist color palette of black and amber-gold
coreInvariants: Total black silhouette of the facial features

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium close-up profile, positioned slightly off-center to the left, facing right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright gold chains at the bottom-left of the silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright jewelry, move up the silhouette edge to the ear, and follow the profile line against the halo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the corners and within the subject's form.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for the subject and outer background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright metallic gold for the jewelry highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black silhouette and the luminous background glow.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for functional metadata only.
graphicDevices: Small rectangular framing for advisory text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a profile silhouette of a man with short hair and thick gold chains, set against a centered circular amber-gold glow on a black background. Ensure the face is completely blacked out.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add small, white, all-caps sans-serif text in the bottom right corner, stacked in three lines.

verificationChecks: Is the face a pure black silhouette?
Is the background glow circular and centered?
Are the gold chains highly reflective?
Is the text small and confined to the bottom right?

adjustableVariables: Thickness and number of gold chains
mustRedesign: Any visible facial features within the silhouette
postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black levels in the silhouette
Verify the glow does not spill into the center of the face
Ensure jewelry highlights are the brightest points in the image
Confirm text is legible but unobtrusive
recipe.reuseFormula: Profile Silhouette + Radial Halo + Metallic Accents
